en: A black-and-white collage-style postcard featuring several prominent views and landmarks of Karlskrona, Sweden. The images display a clock tower, a park with a fountain, a waterfront with boats, residential houses, a statue (Rosenbom), and notable buildings around a main square, including a church and what appears to be a town hall or concert house. The word 'KARLSKRONA' is prominently displayed in large letters in the center, along with a naval insignia.
